Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and serve with cucumber relish.

title: Fish with Lemongrass-Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 400 g cobia or another white fish such as tilapia, halved crosswise
2 scallions (spring onions), cut into 5 cm lengths
steps: Spread the flour on a plate and coat both sides of the fish in it.

Heat the deep-frying oil in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C. Deep-fry the fish for 6-8 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and transfer to a serving plate.

Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a clean wok or skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic, shallot, and lemongrass and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until the shallot has softened and the lemongrass is lightly browned.

Add the tamarind, broth, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir for 4-5 minutes, until the sugar dissolves and the sauce thickens. Add the chile and scallions and cook for 1 minute more. Pour over the fish and serve.

title: Deep-Fried Pork and Crabmeat in Shells
ingredients: Red, green, and orange bell peppers, seeded and sliced, to garnish
Sweet Chili Dipping Sauce (see p. 60), to serve
steps: Combine the pork, water chestnuts, crabmeat, and onions in a large bowl. Add the cilantro roots and soy sauce and mix well.
Spoon the seasoned pork and crab mixture into the crab or scallop shells, then steam for 10-15 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the flour in a bowl until thoroughly combined.
Heat the oil in a large wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Dip each steamed, filled shell into the egg mixture until coated, then carefully lower it into the oil.
Deep-fry for 4-6 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels; repeat with the remaining shells.
Arrange on lettuce leaves, garnish with the sliced peppers, and serve with sweet chili dipping sauce.

title: Sea Bass Wrapped in Kale Leaves
ingredients: 600 g sea bass fillets, cut into 2.5 cm dice
10 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and diced
10 red and green bird's eye chiles, finely chopped
2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: For the sauce, heat a wok over medium heat. Add the sugar and fish sauce and stir for 4-5 minutes, until thick. Remove from the heat, add the lime juice and pickled plum juice, and stir until combined. Transfer to a small serving bowl.
Heat the oil for deep-frying to 180°C, or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the fish for 6-7 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Lay the kale leaves on a large serving plate and place a couple of fish pieces in the center of each leaf. Top with the ginger, limes, chiles, shallot, and peanuts. Serve with the sauce.

title: Deep-Fried Shrimp
ingredients: 250 g shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with Sweet Chili Dipping Sauce (see p. 60), to serve
steps: Put the all-purpose (plain) flour, rice flour, tapioca flour, baking powder, salt, and 5 ml water in a large bowl and mix well until the flours have dissolved. Set aside.
Spread the bread crumbs out on a plate. Dip the shrimp (prawns) into the flour mixture, then coat in the breadcrumbs.

He at the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the shrimp in batches for 4-5 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve with the sweet chili dipping sauce.

title: Deep-Fried Soft-Shell Crab with Garlic
ingredients: 4 x 100 g soft-shell crabs, cleaned and cut into quarters
steps: Heat 75 ml of the oil in a wok over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and fry for 1 minute, until brown and crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Combine the saam-gler, oyster sauce, and sugar in a large bowl. Add the crabs and gently mix to coat.
Heat the remaining oil in a clean wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Deep-fry the crabs for 8-10 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Arrange the crab on lettuce leaves, sprinkle with the crisp garlic, and serve with Thai chili sauce.

title: Deep-Fried Shrimp in Tamarind Sauce
ingredients: 12 jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined
1½ teaspoons Sriracha sauce or other chili sauce (optional)
5 red and green spur chiles, chopped
steps: Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the shrimp (prawns) for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels In a clean wok, mix the Sriracha sauce, if using, sugar, tamarind, chiles, fish sauce, oyster sauce, and 2 tablespoons water together. Put over medium heat and stir for 3-4 minutes or until the mixture starts to become sticky. Add the shrimp and mix well. Sprinkle with the fried garlic and dried chiles and serve.

title: Fried Shrimp in Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 8 jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the galangal, lemongrass, garlic, and shallots, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Add the tamarind, chili jam, oyster sauce, sugar, and 120 ml water and mix well. Add the shrimp (prawns) and fry for 3-4 minutes or until cooked. Sprinkle with the kaffir lime leaves and scallions (spring onions) and serve.

title: Deep-Fried Pork with Garlic and Pepper
ingredients: 500 g pork shoulder, cut into 7.5 x 5 cm pieces, 5 mm thick
Raw vegetables, such as cucumber and lettuce, to serve
steps: Mix the pork, saam-gler, salt, and soy sauce, if using, in a large bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours.
Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Deep-fry the pork for 10-15 minutes, until golden.
Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and serve with glutinous rice and raw vegetables.

title: Deep-Fried Sun-Dried Squid
ingredients: 500 g squid, cleaned and cut into 5 mm-thick rings
steps: Mix the squid, fish sauce, and sugar together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Place the squid on a wire rack, cover with insect proof mesh, and sundry for 3-4 hours or until the squid has dried. Alternatively, let dry at room temperature for 24 hours:.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 375°F/190°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the squid for 2-3 minutes or until cooked and brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels, then serve.

title: Pork Omelet
ingredients: Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Put the eggs, scallion (spring onion), pork, and soy sauce in a bowl and whisk until thoroughly combined. Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet or pan and cook for about 1½ minutes or until golden brown. Carefully flip over the omelet and cook for another 1½ minutes to color the other side. Transfer to a serving plate and serve with rice.

title: Sun-Dried Pork
ingredients: 500 g thin shoulder pork cutlet or pork loin steak, cut into 1.5 cm-wide strips
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: Mix the pork strips and saam-gler in a large bowl. Add the soy sauce, sugar, oyster sauce, sesame seeds, and salt and mix well.
Place the pork on a wire rack or tray, cover with insect-proof mesh, and dry in the sun for 5-6 hours. Alternatively, dry indoors for 24 hours.
Heat the oil for deep-frying to 350°F/180°C. Fry the pork for 8-10 minutes, or until brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels and serve with chili sauce.

title: Crispy Pork Side with Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: Bring a large pan of water to a boil over high heat. Carefully place the pork side (belly), skin side down, in the pan and return to a boil. Add half the salt, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 30 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack, let rest for 5-10 minutes, then pierce the skin all over with a fork. Rub with the vinegar, then the remaining salt. Score the skin in a 1 cm crisscross pattern and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375°F/190°C/Gas Mark 5. Transfer the seasoned pork to a large roasting pan, skin side up, and roast for about 1½ hours. Remove and set aside.

Meanwhile, make the sauce. Bring 250 ml water, the broth (stock), and cilantro (coriander) root to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the remaining ingredients except the cornstarch (cornflour) and boil for 5 minutes or until the mixture has slightly reduced and is thoroughly combined.
Dissolve the cornstarch in 4 tablespoons water and add to the pan, stirring well. Let the sauce boil for another 2 minutes or until thickened.

Heat the oil in a skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Sauté the pork, skin side down, for 2-3 minutes or until the skin is puffed up and crisped, then turn and saute the other side for another 1-2 minutes. Remove, drain, and let cooL.
Slice the cooled pork into bite-size pieces and place on top of the rice. Pour over the sauce and serve with the egg and cucumber.

title: Crispy Chicken and Lemongrass
ingredients: 8 lemongrass stalks, diagonally sliced into 1'-inch 4 cm lengths
1 * 1 lb 300 g boneless chicken thighs, each cut into 4 pieces 4 cm thick:
Sweet Chili Dipping Sauce (see p. 60), to serve
steps: Coarsely pound the lemongrass in a morlar with a pestle until shredded, then use your hand to crumble until finely shredded. Transfer to a small bowl, add the kaffir lime leaves, batter mix, and ½ tablespoon soy sauce, and mix well. Set aside.
Put the chicken and the remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce in another bowl and mix until the chicken is well coated Set aside.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the chicken for 13-15 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Increase the heat for 1 minute, then remove the chicken with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Set aside.

Reduce the temperature to 325°F/160°C or until a cube of bread browns in 45 seconds Deep-fry the lemongrass mixture for about 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Quickly remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Place the chicken on a serving plate, top with the crispy lemongrass, and serve with the sweet chili dipping sauce on the side.

title: Deep-Fried Baby Ribs with Garlic and Peppercorns
ingredients: 800 g boneless baby back ribs, chopped into Ih 4 cm pieces
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Pound the white peppercorns, 10 g garlic cloves, and cilantro (coriander) root in a mortar with a pestle until fine, then add to the bowl with the ribs. Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce, cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm), and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 15-30 minutes.

Meanwhile, for the garnish, coarsely pound the 15 g garlic cloves with the ½ teaspoon soy sauce in a mortar with a pestle. Set aside. Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the ribs for 8-10 minutes until brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Remove half the oil from the wok or deep fryer, reduce the heat to low, and add the pounded garlic mixture. Deep-fry for 1-2 minutes until brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Let cool.
Place the ribs on a serving plate, sprinkle with the crispy garlic, and serve with steamed rice and sliced cucumber.

title: Deep-Fried Bottle Gourd
ingredients: 1 ×400 g young bottle gourd, cut into ½ × 3-inch/1 × 7 cm sticks
steps: For the dipping sauce, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated, then drain and chop.

Pound the chiles, garlic, and tamarind in a mortar with a pestle. Add the salt, sugar, and 1 tablespoon water, then add the cilantro (coriander) and mix together until the salt ana sugar have dissolved. Transfer to a small serving bowl and set aside Spread the tempura batter mix out on a plate and dip the gourd sticks into the batter mix until well coated.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the coated gourd in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Transfer the gourd slices to a serving plate, season with the salt, and serve with the dipping sauce.

title: Deep-Fried Salted Chicken
ingredients: 400 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2.5 cm cubes
2 red spur chiles, diagonally sliced, to garnish
10 dried red bird's eye chiles, seeded
steps: Combine the chicken, garlic, soy sauce, salt, pepper, and sugar in a bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 10-15 minutes.

For the chili dip, toast the dried chiles in a wok over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant and dark. Remove and set aside. Toast the garlic and shallot for 2-3 minutes, or until soft and lightly burned.

Transfer the garlic and shallot to a mortar. Add the toasted chiles, galangal, and shrimp paste and pound until smooth. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and 2 tablespoons water and stir well. Transfer to a serving bowl.

Heat the oil for deep-frying to 350°F/180°C. Deep-fry the chicken for 8-10 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels, garnish with the sliced red chiles, and serve with the roasted chili dip.

title: Raw Soft-Shell Crab in Fish Sauce
ingredients: 10-15 red and green bird's eye chiles, chopped
1 bitter gourd, peeled and thinly sliced
3 cloves garlic, peeled and left whole
steps: Rinse the crabs under cold running water.

Using a pair of sharp scissors, cut off the front part of the crab behind the eyes, then open the top shell and remove and discard the gills. Turn the crab over and remove the apron. Repeat with the remaining crabs.

Place the crabs on a plate with 3 tablespoons fish sauce. Cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and let marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Pound the garlic and the chiles together in a mortar with a pestle. Add the lime juice, sugar, and the remaining fish sauce and stir until thoroughly combined.
Place the marinated crabs on a serving plate and drizzle with the sauce, Arrange the bitter gourd around the crabs and sprinkle with the mint and the whole garlic cloves. Serve.

title: Spicy Water Spinach and Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 4 uncooked jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
3 red finger chiles, sliced into fine strips
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: To make the batter, put the flour, salt, and black pepper into a bowl and stir to combine. Add 175 ml water and stir until a batter forms.
Coat the water spinach in the batter.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Gradually add the coated water spinach to the hot oil, and deep- fry for 4-5 minutes or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Deep-fry the shrimp (prawns) for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Set aside. For the sauce, bring the coconut milk and fish sauce to a boil in a separate wok over medium heat. Add the sugar, chili jam, and lime juice stir, and return to a boil. Remove from the heat.
To serve, place the deep-fried water spinach and shrimp on a serving plate and pour over the sauce. Sprinkle with the chiles and fried shallots and serve.

title: Pork Floss Wrapped in Kale Leaves
ingredients: 5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and cut into 1 cm dice
10-15 red and green bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped
2½ tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: For the dressing, mix the sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, and pickled plum juice, if using, in a pan over medium heat. Stir for about 2 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved and starts to caramelize. Let cool.
Mix the ginger, chiles, shallots, lemongrass, roasted peanuts, limes, pork floss, and dressing together in a large bowl.
To serve, place the kale leaves on a serving plate and put a teaspoon of the pork mixture into the center of each leaf.

title: Spicy Raw Shrimp in Fish Sauce
ingredients: 15 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, to garnish
100 g sliced bitter gourd, to garnish
5 garlic cloves, thinly sliced lengthwise, to garnish
steps: Arrange the uncooked shrimp (prawns) on a serving plate.

Mix the fish sauce with 1½ tablespoons water in a bowl, then pour over the shrimp. Cover the plate with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and chill in the refrigerator for 30-50 minutes or until the shrimp have absorbed the sauce.
To serve, pour the seafood sauce over the shrimp and garnish with the chiles, bitter gourd, garlic, and mint leaves.

title: Stir-Fried Angled Gourd with Egg
ingredients: 1-2 x 400 g angled gourds, peeled and sliced
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Add the gourds and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the eggs and stir-fry for another minute or until the eggs are cooked. Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix well. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Tofu with Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 100 g extra firm tofu, cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the tofu, and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes or until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the oil, then drain the rest from the wok. Increase the heat to medium-high and heat the reserved oil. Add the garlic and bean sprouts and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the chiles, scallions (spring onions), oyster sauce, soy sauce, and tofu and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Basa Fish
ingredients: 1 ×400 g whole basa fish or river cobbler, cleaned
120 g finely sliced heart of palm
7 fresh young green peppercorns, on their stalks
steps: Cut through the basa fish belly and remove the innards, then cut the fish into slices and rinse under cold running water. Drain and set aside.
Roughly pound all the chiles, sliced fingerroot, and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chile mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the sliced fish and stir-fry for 8 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Fish with Vegetables
ingredients: 300 g white fish fillet, cut into K 1 cm slices
5 fresh young green peppercorns (on their stalks)
2 yard-long beans, cut into 5 cm long lengths
steps: Pound the garlic, shallot, and bird's eye chile thoroughly in a mortar with a pestle, then set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the fish, and cook for 2-3 minutes until cooked. Transfer the fish to a plate.

Add the pounded mixture to the wok and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the fish, fingerroot, peppercorns, eggplant (aubergine), baby corn, yard-long beans, and kaffir lime leaves and stir-fry for 1 minute Season with the fish sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and mix well. Add the basil and red spur chiles, then serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Fish with Mixed Vegetables
ingredients: 500 g clown featherback fish or cod fillet, cut into bite-size pieces
3 red and green finger chiles, chopped
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
4 fresh young green peppercorns (on their stalks). to garnish
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Transfer to a mortar with the remaining chili paste ingredients and pound with a pestle until smooth. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chili paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the fish, basil, chiles, fingerroot, eggplant (aubergine), yard-long beans, fish sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 3 minutes or until cooked. Garnish with the green peppercorns and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Spanish Mackerel with Celery
ingredients: 300 g Spanish mackerel fillet, sliced into 3-4 cm pieces
150 g Chinese celery, chopped into 5 cm lengths
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Spread the flour on a plate, coat the fish pieces in it, and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Deep-fry the mackerel for 5-7 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drain all but 2 tablespoons oil from the wok and heat over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Reduce the heat to low. Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salted soybeans, and broth and stir.
Add the fried fish, chiles, and celery and stir-fry for 20 seconds, until thoroughly combined. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Sea Bass with Cardamom Shoots
ingredients: 300 g sea bass fillet, cut into 1 cm pieces
50 g sweet basil leaves, plus extra to serve
steps: Pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle until smooth.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the sea bass and fish sauce and cook for 3-5 minutes. Add the cardamom shoots and basil and cook for another 2 minutes. Serve with extra cardamom shoots, sweet basil, and garlic cloves.

title: Stir-Fried Snakehead Fish with Salted Soybeans
ingredients: 300 g snakehead, catfish, or tilapia fish fillet, cut into bite-size pieces
10 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and finely julienned
5 green finger chiles, cut into strips
150 g chopped Chinese celery, cut into 5 cm lengths
steps: Soak the dried mushrooms in a bowl of boiling water for 10 minutes or until softened. Drain and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant.

Add the fish and stir-fry gently for 3 minutes or until cooked. Add the salted soybeans, sesame oil, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, pepper, and 2 tablespoons water. Stir-fry for 3 minutes, until thoroughly combined.
Add the ginger and cloud ear mushrooms and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the mushrooms are cooked. Add the green chiles and Chinese celery and stir 2-3 times, until well mixed. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Kale with Salted Fish
ingredients: 2 red bird's eye chiles, chopped and pounded
100 g sun-dried salted fish (Spanish mackerel). rinsed, dried, and cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and add the Fried Garlic, chiles, and fish. Then add the kale and stir-fry for about 4 minutes until cooked. Add the oyster sauce and sugar and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Small Horse Mussels
steps: Sort through the mussels and discard any with open shells. Scrub the mussels with a scourer to remove any barnacles and then pull away the beards.

Put the mussels in a wok or pan, cover, and steam over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the shells open and the mussels start to cook. Immediately remove from the heat. When cool enough to handle, remove the mussel flesh from the shells, and sel aside. Discard the shells.

Heat the oil in a clean wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Increase the heat a little, add the mussel meat, soy sauce, and sugar, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until the mussels are cooked. Add the basil leaves and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Shrimp with Rice
ingredients: 5 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, then coarsely chopped
5 red and green bird's eye chiles, pounded
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the shrimp (prawns), chiles, fish sauce, oyster sauce, white pepper, sugar, and broth (stock) and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked.
Place the rice on a serving plate, add the shrimp mixture, garnish with cilantro (coriander), and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Broccoli with Salted Fish
ingredients: 100 g dry salted fish (Spanish mackerel), rinsed, dried, and cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Rinse the Chinese broccoli, then trim the ends of the stems and discard. Cut the stems from the leaves, then slice the stems and leaves diagonally into 4 cm pieces. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat, add the garlic, and saute for 30 seconds. Add the fish and sauté for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the broccoli, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pickled Shrimp
ingredients: dried red chiles, seeded, to garnish (optional)
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pickled shrimp, eggs, bird's eye chiles, and shallot and mix well. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with dried red chiles, if using, and serve with rice.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Seafood
ingredients: 80 ml fish or chicken broth, plus extra if needed
150 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
150 g squid, cleaned and cut into 1 cm-thick rings
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the lemongrass and galangal, and sauté for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the chili jam and fry for another 1 minute or until fragrant, then add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Add the broth (stock), shrimp (prawns), and squid and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Season with the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chiles, and kaffir lime leaves. Stir-fry for another 1 minute, then add the sawtooth cilantro (coriander) and stir until thoroughly combined. Transfer to a serving plate or shallow bowl and add a little more broth. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Melinjo Leaves and Dried Shrimp
ingredients: 100 g melinjo leaves or young spinach
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the shallot and garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the melinjo leaves, eggs, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and salt and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the dried shrimp and stir-fry until thoroughly cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Blue Crab with Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 Chinese celery stalks, cut into 3 cm pieces
3 scallions (spring onions), cut into 3 cm pieces
steps: Put the crabs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Humanely kill each crab by turning it onto its back and piercing through the small hole beneath the tail flap with a sturdy skewer.
Cook the crabs in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then transfer to cold water and let cool. Remove and discard the apron and carapace, rinse clean, and chop each crab into quarters.
Whisk all the sauce ingredients together in a bowl and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chile and sauté for about 10 seconds, then add the crab and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and cook for another 2 minutes. Add the celery and scallions and cook for 1 minute more, then serve.

title: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 300 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined
steps: Put the shrimp (prawns) and salt in a bowl, mix well, and let marinate for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the shrimp, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Transfer to a serving plate and set aside.

Remove all but 3 tablespoons of the oil from the wok. Add the garlic and sautê for 1 minute or until golden, then add the butter, peppercorns, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and sauté for about 30 seconds. Add 2 tablespoons water, mix for another 20 seconds, then pour the garlic sauce over the shrimp. Garnish with the cilantro (coriander) sprigs and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Mushrooms, Baby Corn, and Shrimp
ingredients: 8-10 shrimp, peeled and deveined, with tails intact
14 baby corn, sliced diagonally into 4 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Remove and set aside.
Add the baby corn to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened, adding 60 ml water while stir-frying.
Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another minute, then return the shrimp to the wok. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and scallion and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Squid with Sator Beans
ingredients: 200 g squid, cleaned and cut into small pieces
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
200 g sator or chopped green beans
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chili jam, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the squid, salt, and sugar and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Add the sator or green beans and chiles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Fiddlehead Ferns and Dried Squid
steps: Soak the dried squid in a bowl of warm water for 30 minutes until soft. Drain, then cut into 1 cm slices and set aside.
Blanch the fern leaves in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and plunge immediately into cold water. Drain and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant and golden. Add the squid, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ferns and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Squid
ingredients: 1 x 400 g squid, cleaned and sliced into 1 cm thick rings, tentacles reserved
10 scallions (spring onions), white part only, sliced
steps: Pound the garlic, shallot, shrimp paste, and white pepper in a mortar with a pestle until a smooth paste.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high, add the squid rings and tentacles, and stir-fry for another 5 minutes. Add the scallions (spring onions), oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix well. Add the pickled garlic and stir-fry for another 30 seconds, then serve on a bed of lettuce.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Beef with Peppers
ingredients: 150 g sliced beef tenderloin or fillet
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the beef, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Beef with Broccoli in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 150 g sirloin or tenderloin beef, cut into 5 mm thick slices
400 g Chinese broccoli, cut into 2-inch 5 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the beef and stir-fry for 1 minute, then season with the oyster sauce and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons water and stir-fry for another 2 minutes or until the broccoli has softened slightly. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Cabbage, Pork, and Tofu
ingredients: 125 g egg tofu (see p. 170), cut into 2 cm-thick slices
500 g bok choy (pak choi), cut into 6-7 cm lengths
70 g Chinese celery, cut into 3 cm lengths
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Spread the flour on a plate and dredge the tofu in it until well coated.
Heat 475 ml oil in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C. Reduce the heat to medium and deep-fry the tofu for 4-5 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Combine the oyster sauce and soy sauce in a small bowl.

Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a clean wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the pork and stir-fry for about 1 minute, until it begins to brown. Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the oyster-soy mixture, broth, black pepper, sugar, and celery. Stir well, add the tofu, and gently stir for another 40-50 seconds. Serve with rice.

title: Sweet Stir-Fried Pork
ingredients: 500 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick slices
75 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378) or Shrimp Paste Fried Rice (see p. 383), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant and golden.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 6-7 minutes, until cooked.
Add the light soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper and stir well.
Reduce the heat slightly and cook for 5 minutes, until the liquid reduces and caramelizes. Serve with steamed jasmine rice or shrimp paste fried rice.

title: Stir-Fried Crispy Pork with Red Chili Paste
ingredients: 250 g Crispy Pork Side (see p. 314), cut into bite-size pieces
45 g yard-long beans, cut into 3 cm lengths
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the pork, yard-long beans, oyster sauce, fish sauce, 1-2 tablespoons water, and sugar. Stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until the beans are cooked.
Add the basil and stir a few times until combined. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Crispy Pork with Salted Shrimp
ingredients: 2-3 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped
250 g Crispy Pork Side (see p. 314), cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and chiles and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the salted shrimp and sugar and mix well. Add the crispy pork and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Pork with Basil, Rice, and Fried Egg
ingredients: 100 g pork loin or shoulder, sliced into bite-size pieces
1 yard-long bean, sliced into 2 cm lengths
steps: Pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle, then set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pounded chile mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the yard-long bean, soy sauce, sugar, and oyster sauce and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the basil leaves, stir-fry briefly and remove from the heat.
To serve, arrange the steamed rice on a serving plate, place the pork on top of the rice, and put the fried eggs on top of the pork.

title: Phat Thai without Noodles
ingredients: 100 g extra-firm white or yellow tofu, cut into 1 cm cubes
100 g pork shoulder or pork loin, thinly sliced
10 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined with tails intact
2-3 tablespoons roasted peanuts, finely pounded, plus extra to garnish
2 Chinese chives, cut into 4 cm pieces
Raw vegetables, such as Chinese chives, bean sprouts, and banana blossom, to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Deep-fry the tofu for 4-5 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drain all but 3 tablespoons oil from the wok. Heat over medium heat, add the shallot, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked. Add the pickled radish and fresh shrimp and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the shrimp are cooked.
Add the eggs and cook for 10 seconds. Add the dried shrimp and fried tofu and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Increase the heat slightly. Add the sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, pounded peanuts, fresh chiles, and chile flakes and quickly stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the bean sprouts and chives and stir 2-3 times. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with the extra peanuts and cilantro, and serve with the raw vegetables and lime wedges.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Side
ingredients: 400 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick pieces
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the pork and stir-fry for 6-7 minutes, until cooked and beginning to brown.
Remove the pork with a slotted spoon, reduce the heat to medium, and add the curry paste. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the pork to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until coated with the paste.
Add the sugar and fish sauce and stir until the sugar dissolves. Add the kaffir lime leaves and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 red or green finger chiles, diagonally sliced
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked.
Add the sugar and chiles and stir-fry for another minute. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork with Basil
steps: Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar, then set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the pounded chile mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked.
Add the basil leaves, mix well, and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Siam Cardamom Shoots
ingredients: 200 g African basil leaves and flowers, pounded
1 kg chicken, cut into small pieces
200 g orange finger chiles, sliced into long strips
steps: Heat the oil a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, basil leaves, and chicken, and stir-fry for about 10 minutes. Add the pea eggplants (aubergines), finger chiles, kaffir lime leaves, cardamom shoots, fish sauce, and about 3 tablespoons water and cook for another 3 minutes. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Pork in Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 400 g pork shoulder, cut into 2 mm-thick slices
steps: Mix the pork, egg, tapioca flour, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and brandy or whiskey in a large bowl. Cover and marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the marinated pork and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add 60 ml water and stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until the pork is cooked.
Add the scallions and stir for 30 seconds. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Chicken and Coconut
ingredients: 300 g boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Break open the coconuts and scoop out the coconut meat with a spoon. Cut the meat into bite-size pieces and soak in a bowl of water.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Carefully add 3-4 tablespoons water and the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until cooked.
Add the coconut meat and 60 ml water, mix, and cook for about 4 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and sugar, then stir and cook for 4 minutes, until the chicken has softened.
Add the basil leaves and mix well. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Eggplant
ingredients: 250 g chicken thighs, bone-in, chopped into bite-size pieces
4 yellow round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded
4 green round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the eggplants, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and 2-3 tablespoons water and stir-fry for about 3 minutes, or until the eggplants have softened.
Add the chiles and stir-fry for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 3 dried red spur chiles, seeded and cut into 4 cm pieces
400 g skinless boneless chicken thigh or breast, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over low-medium heat, add the cashew nuts, and fry for 5-6 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Add the dried chiles to the wok and fry for 20-30 seconds or until fragrant and the color turns darker. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Add the chicken to the wok and fry for about 5 minutes or until cooked and golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Drain all but 1 tablespoon of oil from the wok then heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce and sugar, mix well, then add the chicken, cashew nuts, and scallions (spring onions) and stir for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, sprinkle with the fried dried chiles, and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Ginger Chicken
ingredients: 300 g skinless boneless chicken breast, cut into 7 mm-thick slices
1 × 7 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until almost cooked. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and mushrooms, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Adding 2 tablespoons water if the sauce dries out. Add the ginger, black pepper, scallion (spring onion), and chiles and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Straw Mushroom Salad
ingredients: Raw or steamed vegetables, such as cucumber, Chinese greens, yard-long beans, and lettuce, to serve
steps: Pound the chili paste, shrimp paste, and salt together in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and quickly stir-fry for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chili paste and sauté for 3 minutes, until fragrant. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the mushrooms and sugar and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with the shallot, both cilantro, scallions, and mint. Serve with glutinous rice and raw or steamed vegetables.

title: Stir-Fried Silkworm Pupae
ingredients: 200 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
5 bell peppers, seeded and cut into large dice
steps: Soak the mushrooms in a bowl of water for 30 minutes, then drain and rinse. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, shrimp (prawns), and silkworm pupae and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the cucumbers, soaked mushrooms, bell peppers, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, and ketchup and stir well.

Combine the cornstarch (cornflour) and 3 tablespoons of water and add to the wok along with the tomatoes, onion, and scallions (spring onions). Stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the mulberries and stir again. Sprinkle with the red chiles, cilantro (coriander), and white pepper and serve.

title: Fried King Oyster Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g king oyster mushrooms, rinsed and sliced
5 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
4 scallions (spring onions), cut into 1-inch 2.5 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms, oyster sauce, and broth (stock) and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the soy sauce, sugar, and shrimp (prawns) and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked. Add the scallions (spring onions), stir well, then serve.

title: Stir-Fried Chayote Leaves and Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 200 g chayote stems and leaves, chopped
steps: Make a cross on the top of the mushrooms. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the chayote leaves and mushrooms, and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce, white pepper, fried garlic, soy sauce, and chicken broth (stock) and stir-fry for about 1 minute until well mixed and the chayote leaves have softened. Serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Mushrooms with Basil
ingredients: 300 g abalone mushrooms, rinsed and chopped
steps: Finely pound the garlic and chiles in a mortar with a pestle and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pounded mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes until thoroughly combined, then serve.

title: Stir-Fried Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 250 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed and mushrooms halved
3 scallions (spring onions), chopped into 4 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Straw Mushrooms with Pork
ingredients: 5 scallions (spring onions), cut into2.5-5 cm lengths
steps: Put the pork, garlic, and soy sauce into a large bowl and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and let marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the marinated pork, and stir-fry for 2 minutes until half cooked. Add the mushrooms, chile, scallions (spring onions), and oyster sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Eggplant with Ground Pork
ingredients: 2 x 300 g long green eggplants (aubergines), cut crosswise into 5 cm pieces and quartered lengthwise
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the eggplants and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes, adding 2-3 tablespoons water as they cook. Add the sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and salted soybeans and stir until combined.
Cover and cook for another 2 minutes. Add both chiles and the basil and stir briefly. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Jicama
ingredients: 200 g uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails intact
200 g squid, cleaned and sliced, tentacles removed
300 g jicama or white radish, peeled and finely julienned
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant and golden.
Add the shrimp and squid and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked.
Add the jicama or white radish and stir-fry for another 3 minutes. Season with the sugar, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and salt.
Add the scallions and carrot and stir until thoroughly mixed. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Bitter Gourd and Egg
ingredients: 200 g bitter gourd, peeled, halved lengthwise, and cut into 2 mm slices
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Mix the salt and bitter gourd together in a large bowl. Set aside for 15 minutes, then rinse twice with water and drain.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant Increase to the heat to high, add the bitter gourd, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the eggs and stir-fry for about 1 minute or until cooked. Season with the soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Stir-Fried Lotus Stems with Shrimp
ingredients: 8 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
250 g young lotus stems, peeled and cut into 4 cm lengths
Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the shrimp (prawns) and lotus stems, increase the heat, and cook for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and soybeans, stir, and serve with rice.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Jackfruit
ingredients: 400 g young jackfruit, peeled and seeded wearing gloves, and cut into 3 cm slices
5 kaffir lime leaves, chopped, to garnish
15 dried red chiles, seeded a be as poon salt
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated, then drain and chop.
Pound the chiles, salt, shallot, and garlic in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine. Set aside.

Bring a large pan of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the jackfruit slices, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, cut the flesh from the rind, and chop into small pieces. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chopped garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the chili paste, cherry tomatoes, and jackfruit and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until everything is thoroughly combined. Garnish with kaffir lime leaves and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Ivy Gourd with Pork
ingredients: 4 handfuls ivy gourd or spinach leaves
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the pork, oyster sauce, sugar and ivy gourd or spinach leaves and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve:.

title: Stir-Fried Scallion Flowers with Pork Liver
ingredients: 2-3 bunches scallions (spring onions) with flowers, cut into 2-3 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and pork liver and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the pork is cooked.
Add the scallions and soy sauce, mix well, and serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Yard-Long Beans with Pork
ingredients: 400 g pork side (belly), sliced into thin strips
175 g yard-long beans, cut into 2.5-5 cm lengths
3 dried red chiles, seeded and chopped
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and galangal until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked.
Add the yard-long beans, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 4 minutes. Sprinkle with the kaffir lime leaves and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 300 g Thai cabbage leaves (pointed spring cabbage), chopped into 8 cm chunks
steps: Mix the cabbage, fish sauce, garlic, and 2 tablespoons water in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Dried Squid
ingredients: 300 g shredded napa (Chinese) cabbage (2.5 cm pieces)
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the dried squid and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the cabbage, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

title: Fried Spinach with Oyster Sauce
steps: Clean the spinach, shake off excess water, and remove the bottom 5 cm of the stems. Cut the remaining spinach into 4 cm lengths.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high and add the spinach, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked, and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Mekong River Seaweed
ingredients: 120 g pork skin with fat, diced
½ garlic bulb, cloves separated and chopped
steps: Heat the broiler to low. Broil the seaweed sheet until golden, then chop and set aside.
Broil the soybean sheet for about 2 minutes, or until fragrant and dark brown. Cool, then grind in a mortar.
Heat 120 ml of the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the pork skin and fry for 5 minutes, or until golden. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute. Transfer to a plate.

Heat the remaining oil in the wok. Add the chili flakes and ground soybean sheet and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the chopped seaweed, pork skin, and garlic and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes, or until the pork is cooked. Season with salt, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Vegetables
ingredients: 5 amaranth leaves or spinach leaves, chopped
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the fried garlic, kale, amaranth, cabbage, and mushrooms and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and serve.

title: Spicy Stir-Fried Water Spinach
ingredients: 300 g water spinach, chopped into 4-inch 10 cm lengths
3 red bird's eye chiles, diagonally sliced
steps: Put the chicken broth (stock), water spinach, garlic, chiles, oyster sauce, soybeans, and soy sauce in a bowl. Toss and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Carefully add the water spinach mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

title: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 400 g amaranth leaves or spinach, chopped
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the fried garlic and amaranth leaves, and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce and sugar and serve.

title: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Tofu and Garlic
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add all the ingredients and stir-fry for 30-60 seconds or until the amaranth has softened. Serve.

title: Glutinous Rice
steps: Soak the rice in a large bowl of cold water overnight or for at least 3 hours. Wash and drain. Wrap the rice in cheesecloth (muslin) and steam for 30-35 minutes, stirring the rice every 10 minutes until cooked through The rice will look transparent when cooked. Keep covered until ready to serve.

title: Steamed Jasmine Rice
steps: Wash the rice and drain through a strainer (sieve). Transfer to a large pan, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a lid, and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soil. Serve.

title: Crab Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fish sauce, plus extra to serve
1 cucumber, peeled and sliced, to serve
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the egg and stir until half-cooked. Increase the heat to medium-high and add the rice, crabmeat, onion, carrot, tomato, and scallions. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with cilantro. Season with lime juice and serve with the cucumber, scallions, lime wedges, and extra fish sauce.

title: Mackerel Fried Rice
ingredients: 150 g salted horse mackerel or smoked mackerel fillet
4 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped, plus extra to garnish
1 small cucumber, peeled and sliced, to serve
steps: Heat 60 ml oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the mackerel and cook for 3 minutes on each side, until beginning to brown. Let cool, then break into smaller pieces.
Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over medium heat. Add half the shallots and sauté for 1 minute, until softened and fragrant.
Add the rice and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the mackerel and soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the remaining shallots and the chiles and stir until combined. Transfer to a plate, garnish with chopped chiles, and serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

title: Shrimp Paste Fried Rice with Sweet Pork
ingredients: 1 small Chinese pork sausage, diagonally sliced
2 yard-long beans, sliced into 5 mm pieces
120 g pork, cut into small pieces, for the sweet pork
1 tablespoon fish sauce, for the sweet pork
3 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar, for the sweet pork
2 teaspoons dark soy sauce, for the sweet pork
2 teaspoons sliced shallot, for the sweet pork
steps: Put the roasted shrimp paste in a bowl and add 1 tablespoon boiled water. Stir until the shrimp paste becomes liquid, then add the steamed rice and stir until thoroughly combined. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over medium heat, add the rice, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, then remove from the heat and let cool.

Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over low heat, add the dried shrimp, and saute for 2 minutes until crispy. Remove the shrimp with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the sliced Chinese sausage to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked, then remove from the heat.

Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a clean wok over low heat. Roll the oil around the wok so it coats the whole surface of the wok, then pour in the beaten egg and roll around the wok to create a thin omelet. Remove, let cool, then roll up and slice into strips. Set aside.

For the sweet pork, heat 2 tablespoons water in a wok over medium heat, add the pork, fish sauce, and sugar, and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Add the soy sauce and shallot, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked, then remove from the heat.

Place the rice on a serving plate, then arrange the sweet pork, shallots, fried dried shrimp sliced chiles, mango, yard-long beans, and fried dried chiles on the side. Sprinkle with the sliced omelet and serve with the lime.

title: Shrimp Paste Fried Rice
ingredients: 500 g Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 318), warm
5 red and green bird's eye chiles, chopped
1 sour green mango or sour green apple, shredded
steps: To make the crispy shrimp, heat the oil in a wok over low-medium heat. Add the dried shrimp and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Remove from the wok with a slotted spoon and sel aside on paper towels.

In a clean wok, make the omelet. Add 1 teaspoon of oil, and roll around the wok. Add 75 ml of the beaten egg and roll around the wok to create a thin crepe Cook for about 2 minutes until set. Put the omelet on a plate and set aside. Repeat this process with another teaspoon of oil and the remaining egg until all the egg is used, adding a teaspoon of oil at a time. Stack the omelets, then cut them into quarters and slice them into Ys 1 cm-thick strips. Set aside.

Put the cooked rice in a large bowl. Mix ½ tablespoon water with the shrimp paste until combined, then add to the rice. Using your hands, gently mix until the rice is well coated with shrimp paste. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic and shallot, and saute until fragrant. Add the rice, stir, and toes the mixture for 2-3 minutes until the rice is hot and a slightly darker color.

To serve, fill a small bowl to the rim with the rice and turn upside down in the middle of a serving plate. Top the rice with the chiles, then place the omelet strips, crispy shrimp, pork, mango, sliced shallots, and lime wedges to the side of the rice.

title: Fried Brown Rice with Shrimp
ingredients: 300 g shrimp (prawns), peeled, deveined, and tails intact
½ Lebanese cucumber, peeled and sliced
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the shrimp (prawns) and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until they turn pink. Add the eggs and cook for 1 minute until cooked. Add the rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the tofu, sugar, and soy sauce and stir-fry for another 1 minute until fragrant. Add the peas, carrot, and onion and stir-fry for another 1 minute Garnish with the cucumber, tomato, cilantro (coriander), scallion (spring onion), and corn kernels and serve.

title: Rice with Black Sesame Seeds
steps: Toast the black sesame seeds in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until fragrant. Remove from the heat and pound in a mortar with a pestle until a fine powder. Add the rice and pound together. Add the salt and sugar and continue to pound until combined. Serve.

title: Spicy Shrimp Fried Rice
ingredients: 10 shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined with tails intact
10 red and green bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chiles and stir-fry for another 30 seconds, until thoroughly combined.
Serve with the scallions and cucumber.

title: Thai Chicken with Seasoned Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 x 2.5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and chopped
250 ml oil from Fried Shallots (see p. 64)
6 tablespoons Fried Shallots (see p. 64), to garnish
1 small scallion (spring onion), about 7.5 cm long
100 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
Raw vegetables, such as lettuce and cucumber, to serve
steps: For the dipping sauce, pound the cilantro root, pickled garlic, and garlic cloves together in a mortar until smooth; remove and set aside.
Pound the peppermint leaves, scallion, and chiles together in the same mortar and set aside.

Pour 250 ml water into a large wok or pan. Add the salt, sugar, and tamarind and cook over medium heat, stirring. Stir in both pounded mixtures and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring continuously. Transfer to a serving bowl and set aside.
For the rice, pound the cilantro root, garlic, and peppercorns together until smooth, then set aside. Separately pound the ginger and shallots.
Heat the fried-shallot oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the cilantro-root mixture and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the pounded ginger and shallots and sauté for another 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken, evaporated milk, lime juice, tomatoes, cilantro stem, pandan leaves, sugar, and salt and stir to combine.
Transfer to a large pan and add 1 liter water. Bring to a boil, then add the rice, masala powder, and saffron and stir well.
Cover and cook over medium heat for about 30 minutes. Add the butter and stir until thoroughly combined.
Garnish with the fried shallots and serve with the dipping sauce, raw vegetables, and cilantro.

title: Crispy Curry Rice with Fermented Pork
ingredients: 10 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and very finely sliced
steps: Bring a pan of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the pork skin and cook for 20-25 minutes. Drain and trim off the extra fat underneath the skin. The skin should be 7 mm thick. Slice into thin strips about 2.5 mm thick and 5 cm long. Set aside.
Put the steamed rice and curry paste into a large bowl and mix well. Break in the egg, add the salt, and knead by hand until combined, then mold into egg-size balls.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 180°C, or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Deep-fry the rice balls for 7-9 minutes until brown and crispy. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and set aside.
Deep-fry the dried chiles for 10 seconds, then remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and set aside.
Put the crispy rice balls into a large bowl and break them into small pieces. Add the fermented pork, shallots, ginger, and three-quarters of the scallions and mix until combined.
Season to taste with the lime juice and fish sauce. Add the peanuts and fried chiles and mix again. Garnish with the remaining scallions and serve with lettuce.

title: Rice with Coconut Milk
steps: Wash the rice and drain through a strainer (sieve). Heat the coconut milk, 230 ml waler, sugar, and salt in a large nonstick pan over medium heat and stir until the sugar and salt have dissolved. Reduce the heat to low and add the rice. Cover with a lid and cook for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soft. Serve.

title: Rice with Coconut Water
ingredients: 100 g shredded young coconut meat, plus extra to garnish
steps: Put the cooked rice into a large bowl and pour over the coconut water. Add the coconut meat and salt to taste and mix well. Add sugar if you prefer a sweeter taste. Serve garnished with coconut flesh.

title: Thai Pork Fried Rice with Fried Eggs
ingredients: 150 g pork loin or shoulder, cut into thin slices
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add 2 of the eggs, one at a time, and fry for 2 minutes. Remove, cover to keep warm, and set aside.

Drain all but 2 tablespoons oil from the wok and reduce the heat to medium. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until cooked. Add the remaining egg, gently beat, and cook for 40-50 seconds until the egg is lightly cooked. Add the rice and stir- fry for another 1 minute or until well mixed then season with the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes until well combined. Add the kale, onions, and tomato wedges and stir fry for 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place the rice on serving plates, top with a fried egg, and arrange the cucumber and lime wedges on the side.

title: Glutinous Coconut Rice in Palm Leaves
ingredients: 500 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: Preheat a charcoal or gas grill to 200°C, or preheat an indoor broiler to medium.
Mix the flours, sugars, coconut, and salt in a large bowl.

Lay out a palm leaf and place 1 tablespoon of the rice mixture lengthwise on it. Cover with another palm leaf and pin the top, middle, and bottom with small bamboo pins or toothpicks. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Grill or broil over medium-low heat for 10 minutes on each side. Serve.

title: Glutinous Rice in a Banana Leaf
ingredients: banana leaves, cut into 6 x 7-inch/15 x 18 cm rectangles
steps: Soak the beans and glutinous (sticky) rice in separate bowls of cold water overnight. The next day, drain the rice and beans.
Bring 1 liter water to a boil in a large pan, add the beans, and cook for 25 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, pound the cilantro (coriander) roots and pepper in a mortar with a pestle. Set aside.
Put the beans and the cilantro root mixture in a wok and stir-fry over medium heat for about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside.

Combine the coconut milk, sugar, and salt in another wok and cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sugar and salt have dissolved. Add the drained rice and cook for another 7 minutes, stirring continuously. Stir until the rice absorbs all the liquid, then slowly add the coconut cream. Mix well and cook for another 20 minutes. Let cool.

Lay a banana leaf on a work surface. Put 1 tablespoons of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf and flatten. Place one-quarter of a banana and 1 tablespoon of beans on top. Fold the banana leaf over the filling, tucking in the side to form a package and secure with string. Steam the packages in a steamer for 45-60 minutes or until the rice has softened. Serve.

title: Baked Pineapple and Rice
ingredients: 70 g chicken breast, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: To prepare the pineapple, cut off the stem, then cut across the top about 3 cm from the crown and set it aside as a lid. Use a long, thin knife to cut along the inside of the pineapple and loosen the flesh, then scoop it out to leave a hollow pineapple bowl. Set 80 g of the flesh aside, cut the remaining flesh into small chunks, and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F/Gas Mark 4).
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chicken, and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the shrimp and cook for another minute, or until the chicken and shrimp are cooked.
Add the rice, pineapple chunks, and red bell pepper and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the curry powder, soy sauce, sugar, and salt and stir-fry for another minute, or until thoroughly combined.
Spoon the mixture into the pineapple bowl and bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and top with the pork floss and cashew nuts. Cover with the pineapple lid and serve.

title: Fried Rice with Pineapple
ingredients: 120 g shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails intact
250 g pineapple, cut into 2 cm dice
2 scallions (spring onions), thinly sliced, to garnish
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for about 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until pink. Remove the shrimp from the wok and set aside.
Add the steamed rice to the wok and stir for about 1 minute, or until the rice is well coated with the oil. Add the soy sauce, sugar, and shrimp and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the pineapple and cashew nuts and cook for another minute, stirring gently. Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with the scallions. Serve with the lime wedges.

title: Glass Noodle and Fried Pork Spicy Salad
ingredients: 10 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails still intact
2 scallions (spring onions), cut into 2.5 cm slices
steps: Soak the noodles in water for 10 minutes. Drain and cook in boiling water for 1 minute, or according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.
Boil the shrimp for 2-3 minutes, then remove with a slotted spoon and drain. Return the water to a boil and cook the ground pork for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Mix the chili jam, lime juice, fish sauce, and sugar in a bowl to make the dressing.
Put the noodles, shrimp, chicken, pork, dried shrimp, and fried garlic in a serving bowl. Add the dressing and mix well.
Add the scallions, Chinese celery, and crispy pork skin, mix again, and serve.

title: Phuket-Style Stir-Fried Hokkien Noodles
ingredients: 50 g fresh squid, cleaned, with tentacles set aside
50 g sea bass, cut into pieces
200 g napa (Chinese) cabbage, cut into 5 cm lengths
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the shallots, and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until soft and beginning to brown.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the squid tubes and tentacles, shrimp, fish, and oysters and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked.
Add the noodles and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until softened. Season with both soy sauces and stir until thoroughly combined.
Add the napa cabbage and broth and stir-fry for 1 minute more.
Remove the wok from the heat and serve with the poached eggs on top.

title: Crispy Rice Noodles with Herbs
ingredients: 2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
steps: Soak the noodles in a bowl of water for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain and set aside.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Fry the rice noodles in batches for 1 minute, then remove and drain on paper towels Deep-fry the kaffir lime leaves, dried chiles, and sliced lemongrass in the same oil for 30 seconds until crispy. Remove from the wok and drain on paper towels.

Bring the tamarind, chili flakes, salt, sugar, and glucose syrup to a boil in a clean wok. Stir continuously. Keep boiling for 5 minutes. Slowly pour the tamarind sauce over the fried rice noodles and stir until thoroughly combined. Serve.
Alternatively, let cool, transfer to in an airtight container, and store in the refrigerator for up to 15 days.

title: Spicy Noodles, Pork, and Seafood Salad
ingredients: 50 g chopped Chinese celery, cut into 4 cm length pieces
steps: Soak the noodles in a bowl of water for 10 minutes, or prepare according to package directions. Drain, cut, and set aside.
Cook the pork in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes until cooked, then drain and set aside.

Cook the squid in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes until cooked, then drain and set aside. Cook the shrimp (prawns) in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes until the shrimp change color, then drain and set aside. To make the spicy sauce, mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chiles, and pickled garlic juice, if using, together in a bowl until the sugar has dissolved. Set aside.

Cook the noodles in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes until soft and cooked, Drain and rinse in cold water and drain again. Transfer to a bowl, add the shrimp (prawns), squid pork, onion, cilantro (coriander), celery, tomato, and the sauce and mix well. Sprinkle with the peanuts and serve.

title: Phat Thai Wrapped in Eggs
ingredients: 1½ tablespoons finely chopped sweet fermented radish
50 g fresh extra-firm tofu, cut into 1 cm cubes
80 g uncooked jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined, tails still intact
100 g bean sprouts, plus extra to serve
20 g chopped Chinese chives, cut into 4 cm lengths
30 g unsalted peanuts, roasted and crushed
steps: Soak the dried noodles in water for 10 minutes, or according to the package directions, until soft. Drain and set aside.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, and tamarind in a small bowl. Set aside.

Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add 3 tablespoons oil, the shallots, garlic, and fermented radish and sauté for 1 minute. Add the dried shrimp and fry for 1 minute. Add the tofu and cook for 1 minute. Add the shrimp and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until pink and cooked. Push everything to one side of the pan.

Add the noodles and broth to the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute without mixing them with the other ingredients. Add the sauce and continue to stir-fry the noodles for 2 minutes, or until cooked and the sauce starts to dry. Mix everything together, then add the bean sprouts, chives, and peanuts. Stir well, remove from the heat, divide into three portions, and set aside.
Heat 1½ teaspoons oil in a wok over medium heat and roll the oil around the wok. When hot, add 75 ml beaten egg and roll it in a circular motion to make a thin, 25 cm omelet.
When cooked, place the omelet in a 16 cm bowl. Put one portion of noodles in the omelet and fold it over the noodles. Invert the bowl onto a serving plate. Repeat with the remaining egg and noodles.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges and raw bean sprouts.

title: Drunken Noodles with Pork
ingredients: 7 red and green bird's-eye chiles, pounded
150 g Chinese broccoli, cut into 4 cm lengths
steps: Separate the noodle strips. If refrigerated, wrap them in cheesecloth and steam for 2-3 minutes, microwave for 1 minute, or prepare according to package directions. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and chiles and stir-fry for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the broccoli and baby corn and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes.
Add the noodles, mushrooms, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the noodles are soft and fully flavored.
Add the basil leaves, stir a few times, and serve.

title: Fried Noodles in Coconut Milk with Shrimp
ingredients: 15 dried red bird's eye chiles, seeded
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
raw or steamed vegetables, such as cucumber. bean sprouts, and yard-long beans
steps: Soak the noodles in a bowl of water for 10 minutes or according to package directions, until soft. Drain and set aside.
Pound the shallots and chiles together in a mortar with a pestle until smooth, then add the shrimp paste and pound until combined.

Bring the coconut milk to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chili paste, stir, and boil for about 2 minutes. Add the sugar, tamarind salt, and a pinch of black pepper, and stir until combined and beginning to boil. Add the shrimp (prawns) and cook for 1-2 minutes until the shrimp turn pink and are cooked. Add the noodles and stir for 3-4 minutes until thoroughly combined and the noodles are soft, and the sauce has dried out. Add a little water if the sauce has dried out but the noodles are still not soft enough to serve. Serve with raw or steamed vegetables.

title: Fried Noodles with Chicken and Gravy
ingredients: 400 g chicken breast, cut into ½ cm strips
80 ml vegetable oil, plus extra for drizzling
250 g bamboo shoots in brine, drained and cut into 1 cm batons
150 g canned champignon or white button mushrooms
2 scallions (spring onions), cut into 1 cm batons
a selection of condiments, such as granulated sugar, dried chili flakes, fish sauce, and white vinegar
steps: Put the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon tapioca flour in a shallow bowl, add the chicken, and mix to coat. Cover and leave for at least 10 minutes.

Bring a half-full pan of water to a boil. Cook the noodles in batches for 2-3 minutes at a time, or according to the package directions. Remove with a slotted spoon, arrange on a serving plate, drizzle with oil to prevent sticking, and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until golden and fragrant. Add the chicken, increase the heat slightly, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until it starts to cook.

To make the gravy, pour in the broth and bring to a boil. Add the salted soybeans, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and black pepper. Reduce the heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked.

Put the remaining tapioca flour in a bowl, add 75 ml water, and stir until smooth. Increase the heat under the wok to medium and add the tapioca mixture in small amounts to thicken the gravy; it should be thick but not gloopy.
Add the bamboo shoots and mushrooms, return to a boil, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Spoon the chicken and gravy over the noodles and garnish with the scallions and chiles. Serve with the condiments.

title: Korat-Style Fried Noodles
ingredients: 4 Chinese chives, cut into 4 cm pieces
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the shallots and garlic and stir-fry for about 1 minute, until golden.
Add the broth, fish sauce, sugar, tamarind puree, chile powder, and salted soybeans and bring to a boil.

Quickly rinse the noodles under cold running water, add them to the wok, and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, or according to package directions, until soft and almost dry. Add a little water if the broth evaporates before the noodles cook.
Reduce the heat and add the scallions, bean sprouts, and chives. Mix well and stir-fry for another 30 seconds. Serve.

title: Rice Noodles with Pork
ingredients: 100 g pork shoulder or tenderloin, thinly sliced
200 g Chinese broccoli, cut into 4 cm lengths
steps: Separate the noodle strips. If refrigerated, wrap them in cheesecloth and steam for 3-5 minutes to warm through, or microwave for 1 minute. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and quickly stir-fry for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute, until cooked.
Add the rice noodles and stir-fry for another 1 minute, until softened. Season with the soy sauce and sugar, then add the broccoli and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Move the noodle mixture to one side of the wok. Break in the egg, beat it, and let it begin to set before moving the noodles back into the center.
Stir-fry for another minute, until thoroughly combined, and serve.

title: Crispy Rice Vermicelli with Calamansi Sauce
ingredients: 100 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled, deveined, and coarsely chopped
1 tablespoon calamansi (Chinese orange) or white passion fruit juice
1½ tablespoons julienned calamansi or passion fruit zest
100 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
1 red spur chile, seeded and sliced
raw or steamed vegetables, such as yard-long beans, bean sprouts, and cucumbers
steps: Soak the vermicelli in a bowl of water for 5 minutes, or according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.

Heat the oil for deep-frying to 180°C (350°F), or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Spread 30 g portions of vermicelli around the wok and deep-fry for 1 minute at a time, or until golden and crisp on both sides. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and repeat with the remaining vermicelli.
In the same wok, pour the beaten egg through a fine strainer and drizzle it around the wok from about 20 cm above to create an egg mesh. Remove and drain on paper towels.
Deep-fry the tofu for 2 minutes, or until golden brown, then remove and drain. Deep-fry the shrimp for 1-2 minutes, then remove and drain.
Pound all the paste ingredients in a mortar with a pestle.

For the sauce, heat the oil in a clean wok over medium heat. Add the paste and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant. Add the tamarind, calamansi or passion fruit juice and zest, lime juice, both sugars, salt, vinegar, ketchup, and fish sauce and stir for 4-5 minutes, or until thickened.
Add the fried shrimp and tofu and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the crispy noodles and stir until completely coated in the sauce.
Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with the egg mesh, scallions, bean sprouts, chile, cilantro, and fried shallots. Serve with raw or steamed vegetables.

title: Rice Noodles with Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 500 g snakehead fish, sea bass, or sea bream, filleted and cut into bite-size pieces
1 kg cooked rice noodles, to serve
270 g chopped yard-long beans, to serve
2 handfuls water mimosa, coarsely chopped, to serve
20 g dried chile flakes, to serve
steps: Bring 250 ml water and the broth to a boil in a large pan.
Add the chiles, garlic, shallots, galangal, lemongrass, fingerroots, and fermented fish sauce and boil for about 7 minutes.
Add the fish, reduce the heat, and simmer for 10 minutes, until softened.
